title: Trading Systems Engineers
description:
About the role

Trading Systems runs the infrastructure Flow Traders trades on: the global Linux fleet - trading servers, workstations and VDIs - and the multi-cloud and distributed-systems estate that sits alongside it. We also build and run the self-service infrastructure platform the rest of Technology depends on.

We are hiring two engineers into this team. This is a hands-on engineering role: most of your time goes on writing Terraform, building CI workflows and guardrails, automating toil out of the Linux fleet, and operating what you build. A lot of the shared tooling does not exist yet, and building it is the job rather than a side effect of it. The environment is trading-critical and runs across both on-premise infrastructure and public cloud, and you will work on both sides of that line rather than specialising in one.

To be clear about the shape of the seat: this is build-and-operate rather than architecture, strategy or management. There is architecture in it, but the bulk of the work is hands-on and there are no direct reports. A solid Linux foundation is essential across the whole role - it underpins both sides of the estate, and the cloud, container and Kubernetes work rests on it just as much as the on-premise fleet does.

What you will do

• Write, debug and publish reusable Terraform modules that other engineers consume, covering both the Linux fleet and the cloud estate.

• Design and own CI/CD workflows and guardrails in GitHub Actions - the policy checks, tests and approval gates that let engineers across Technology self-serve infrastructure safely.

• Build and operate Kubernetes on both sides of the estate - managed clusters in cloud and k3s on-premise - along with the distributed systems running on it, particularly Kafka.

• Provision and operate GCP, AWS and Alibaba Cloud resources through Infrastructure as Code.

• Operate and automate the Linux estate: Foreman provisioning across VMs and bare metal, Puppet for host configuration, Ansible/AWX for application deployment, plus patching and lifecycle.

• Build automation and internal tooling in Python or Go, with test-driven development as a normal working habit.

• Take a share of the global 24/7 on-call rotation, and cross-skill deliberately between the Linux and cloud sides of the estate.

What you will need to succeed

• Strong Terraform experience, including writing, debugging and producing reusable modules for others to consume.

• CI/CD experience, ideally GitHub Actions - and the guardrails, not only the pipelines. We want to hear about the gates and policy checks you built and why each one exists. Equivalent GitLab CI or Jenkins experience is fine.

• Solid Kubernetes in production across workloads, CNI, Helm and Argo. Self-managed or bare-metal clusters are a strong plus, as is contributing to or authoring operators.

• Hands-on experience provisioning and operating GCP or AWS through Infrastructure as Code, with an appetite to go deeper.

• Strong Linux fundamentals - you can debug a production host without a runbook: processes, networking, storage, systemd, logs, kernel versus user space.

• Proficiency in Python or Go, with demonstrable experience of test-driven development.

• Direct experience of production on-call and incident response, and a considered view on what makes a rotation sustainable.

• Typically 5+ years in infrastructure, platform or systems engineering. Fluent written and spoken English. Based in the Amsterdam area or willing to relocate - this role is on-site and is not remote.

description:
Job Title: Entry-Level HR Manager
Location: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Company: Everglade Works

Job Type: Full-Time | Entry Level | Remote
About the Role
This isn't your typical HR generalist role with a fancy title. At Everglade Works , were scaling fast, and we need someone who's ready to step into the drivers seat of day-to-day HR operations. This is a hands-on position for someone who wants to understand the rea workings of people management in a growing IT company.
You'll work side-by-side (virtually) with leadership to help build and maintain a workplace that runs smoothly, keeps people engaged, and ensures the human side of the business is just as sharp as the tech.
What You'll Be Doing

• Manage onboarding from A to Z paperwork, tools, welcome calls, the works

• Coordinate with team leads to support new hires during their first weeks

• Track employee datacontract dates, birthdays, leave balances, updates

• Be the first point of contact for HR-related questions from our remote team

• Help draft internal communicationspolicies, process guides, updates

• Keep our digital HR files organized and audit-ready

• Support offboarding: making sure exits are smooth, respectful, and well-documented

• Assist with hiring tasks (scheduling interviews, collecting feedback, etc.)

• Spot gaps in our HR processes and work with us to make them better

You'll Thrive in This Role If You

• Have some background in HR (internship, assistant role, or a degree/cert is great we are not rigid)

• Understand that HR isn't just about policies its about people

• Can juggle tasks without needing someone to check in on you every hour

• Know your way around Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Forms, Calendar)

• Communicate clearly and professionallywhether by email, Slack, or on a Zoom call

• Are detail-oriented without being roboticyes, typos matter, but so does tone

• Know how to handle sensitive info with care and discretion

• Are curious, humble, and eager to learn how HR really works in the tech world

What You'll Get in Return

• A real shot to grow into a senior HR leader no waiting years to get noticed

• Direct access to the leadership team you'll actually be heard

• Remote-first flexibility work from where you're most productive

• Paid time off (yes, even in your first year)

• Health, dental, and vision benefits (for U.S. employees)

• A team that genuinely respects the value of HR this isn't just a checkbox role

How to Apply
If you're looking for a corporate HR job where you push paper all day this isn't it.
But if you're looking for a real opportunity to build, grow, and be taken seriously in your first HR role, hit that apply button and show us what you're about.
Everglade Works is a people-first company. We believe great ideas and talent come from everywhere, and were committed to building a team that reflects the world we work in.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Maritime Digital Production (MDP) is the software and digital systems function within Anduril's Heavy Metal division. We build and deploy the full technology stack that powers Anduril's shipbuilding factories: the data infrastructure that makes every machine and sensor visible in real time, the manufacturing execution system (ArsenalOS) that workers and planners use every shift, the scheduling engine that replans production in minutes instead of days, and the AI systems that eliminate manual toil from both the shop floor and business operations.

MDP operates at the boundary between Operational Technology and Information Technology. Our systems live where factory-floor machines, edge compute, and OT networks meet enterprise platforms and cloud infrastructure. We incubate solutions close to the production line, validate them with real operators building real hardware, harden them for reliability and security, and then scale them across multiple sites. The environment is fast, physical, and consequential. When our systems go down, production stops. The output of our work is not a dashboard: it is a ship.

This is not a support function. It is a strategic investment by Anduril in the premise that digitizing the manufacturing lifecycle end-to-end, from engineering definition through scheduling through execution through field feedback, is how Heavy Metal will out-build, out-adapt, and out-scale the traditional defense industrial base. MDP is scaling from a founding team to 70+ engineers across multiple U.S. sites. You will be joining early, working on hard problems with real operational stakes, and shaping how manufacturing software is built at Anduril from the ground up.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Senior Numerical Optimization Engineer on this unique initiative, you will own the scheduling optimization core that decides when and how ships get built. This project represents a shipyard's work as a graph of 100,000+ manufacturing operations carrying precedence, spatial, resource, and qualification constraints, then continuously replans as the factory changes. You will formulate that problem, build and benchmark the solvers that attack it, and keep them fast and trustworthy enough that a new plan can reach the floor within minutes of a disruption.

This is a research-grade problem with production consequences. Resource-constrained project scheduling at this scale is NP-hard, there is no ground truth to measure against, and a schedule has to be stable enough that the shop floor is not thrashed every time it changes. You will have the latitude to develop novel approaches and the obligation to ship them.
